title: Petty cash not reconciled monthly
description: Petty cash for the head office float was last reconciled in June. Three monthly reconciliations are missing and no one has signed off the balance.

title: Supplier bank details changed without verification
description: Bank details for two suppliers were changed on an emailed request with no call-back check to a known contact.

title: Stock counts not done at the regional store
description: The quarterly stock count at the regional store was skipped for Q2 and Q3. Book stock cannot be confirmed.

title: Leavers still active on the payroll system
description: Four staff who left in August still have active payroll records. No payments were made, but the accounts were not closed.

title: Vehicle logbooks incomplete
description: Logbooks for six pool vehicles have missing trip entries and no supervisor signature for September.

title: Shared administrator password on the finance server
description: The finance server uses one administrator account shared by three staff, so actions cannot be traced to a person.

title: Fixed asset tags missing
description: A sample of 40 assets found 9 without asset tags, so they cannot be matched to the register.

title: Purchase orders raised after invoices
description: Seven purchase orders were created after the supplier invoice date, which bypasses approval before commitment.

title: Training records not filed
description: Mandatory induction records for new staff since March are not on personnel files.

title: Backups not tested
description: Nightly backups run, but no restore has been tested in the last twelve months.

title: Fuel card limits not set
description: Fuel cards for field vehicles have no daily limits configured with the provider.

title: Goods received without inspection notes
description: Deliveries in August were accepted at the store without signed inspection notes.
